adaptive.question: Which workspace is most useful next? Prioritize the technician working notes over the older job record. A return of the same symptom after repair is a comeback even if a part is mentioned. These are workflow suggestions, not technical diagnosis.

choices.diagnose: A new fault or intermittent symptom needs investigation; no confirmed failed part yet.
choices.parts: A specific failed part or needed replacement has been identified. The next step is parts coordination.
choices.comeback: A previous repair has failed or the same problem has returned after a recent visit.
choices.clarify: Too little or conflicting information to select an appropriate next workspace.

case.question: Do the working notes explicitly REQUEST reviewing or comparing the equipment history or previous service visits? Answer yes only for an explicit request to investigate history. Merely reporting a previous failure or a replacement part is not a request.

no.question: Which supporting panel is useful NOW? Current SQL facts.readiness and current_readiness_explanation supersede historical working notes about parts availability. Choose schedule when current readiness is ready or scheduled, even if old notes mention waiting or a failed repair. Choose parts while current readiness is waiting. Only choose equipment instead when notes explicitly request investigation/history, not merely mention a past failure. Role is a tie-breaker. This selects information and never authorizes work.

choices.equipment: Working notes explicitly request equipment investigation or review of previous service.
choices.parts: Current SQL facts.readiness is waiting: parts are still backordered.
choices.schedule: Current SQL facts.readiness is ready, scheduled, released or complete: follow the appointment and handoff. Older notes about waiting for parts are superseded.

deals.sql: SELECT *, '$'||to_char(price,'FM999,999,990') AS price_label, address||' · '||owner AS title FROM calliope_apps.demo_deals WHERE ($1='Everyone' OR owner=$1) ORDER BY closing_date,id

deal.sql: SELECT id,version,address,buyer,stage,price,'$'||to_char(price,'FM999,999,990') price_label,jsonb_build_array(owner) owner,closing_date,notes FROM calliope_apps.demo_deals WHERE id=$1

tasks.sql: SELECT t.*,CASE WHEN done=1 THEN 'Complete' ELSE 'Open' END AS label FROM calliope_apps.demo_tasks t WHERE deal_id=$1 ORDER BY due,id

jobs.sql:
SELECT j.*, j.scheduled_date||' · '||j.slot||' · '||j.technician AS detail FROM calliope_apps.demo_hvac_jobs j
      WHERE ($1='Everyone' OR j.technician=$1) AND j.scheduled_date::date >= current_date - $2::integer
      AND ($3='All' OR j.status=$3) AND (j.customer ILIKE '%'||$4||'%' OR j.id ILIKE '%'||$4||'%')
      ORDER BY j.scheduled_date DESC,j.slot,j.id LIMIT 30

job.sql:
SELECT j.id,j.version,j.customer,j.address,jsonb_build_array(j.technician) technician,j.job_type,j.scheduled_date,
      coalesce(s.start,'08:00') start,coalesce(s."end",'10:00') "end",'' reason,j.notes,j.status,j.equipment,
      '$'||to_char(j.amount_cents/100.0,'FM999,999,990.00') amount_label,
      coalesce(o.id,'') order_id, CASE WHEN coalesce(sum(l.backorder),0)>0 THEN 'Waiting for parts' ELSE 'Parts ready' END AS parts, j.scheduled_date || ' · ' || coalesce(s.start,'08:00') || ' · ' || j.technician AS appointment, CASE WHEN coalesce(sum(l.backorder),0)>0 THEN 'Next: coordinate the outstanding parts' WHEN j.status='Complete' THEN 'Next: review the service report' ELSE 'Next: review the visit and handoff' END AS next_step
      FROM calliope_apps.demo_hvac_jobs j LEFT JOIN calliope_apps.demo_dispatch_slots s ON s.job_id=j.id
      LEFT JOIN calliope_apps.demo_counter_orders o ON o.visit_id=j.id LEFT JOIN calliope_apps.demo_counter_order_lines l ON l.order_id=o.id
      WHERE j.id=$1 GROUP BY j.id,s.start,s."end",o.id

products.sql: SELECT p.*, '$'||to_char(price_cents/100.0,'FM999,990.00') AS price_label, coalesce(s.on_hand-s.reserved,0)/100.0 available FROM calliope_apps.demo_counter_products p LEFT JOIN calliope_apps.demo_counter_stock s ON s.product_id=p.id AND s.branch='north' ORDER BY p.name

quotes.sql: SELECT id,customer_id,branch,status FROM calliope_apps.demo_counter_quotes ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 30

quote.sql:
SELECT q.id,q.version,q.customer_id,jsonb_build_array(q.branch) branch,q.notes,q.status,
      coalesce((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(l.id,jsonb_build_object('quantity',round(l.quantity/100.0,2)::text,'unit_price',round(l.unit_price/100.0,2)::text)) FROM calliope_apps.demo_counter_lines l WHERE l.quote_id=q.id),'{}'::jsonb) lines,
      '$'||to_char(coalesce((SELECT sum(round(l.quantity*l.unit_price/100.0))/100.0 FROM calliope_apps.demo_counter_lines l WHERE l.quote_id=q.id),0),'FM999,999,990.00') total_label,
      coalesce((SELECT id FROM calliope_apps.demo_counter_orders WHERE quote_id=q.id),'') order_id
      FROM calliope_apps.demo_counter_quotes q WHERE q.id=$1

quoteLines.sql:
SELECT l.*,p.name,p.unit, (coalesce(s.on_hand,0)-coalesce(s.reserved,0))/100.0 available,
      '/state/quoteForm/lines/'||l.id||'/quantity' quantity_path, '/state/quoteForm/lines/'||l.id||'/unit_price' price_path
      FROM calliope_apps.demo_counter_lines l JOIN calliope_apps.demo_counter_products p ON p.id=l.product_id JOIN calliope_apps.demo_counter_quotes q ON q.id=l.quote_id
      LEFT JOIN calliope_apps.demo_counter_stock s ON s.product_id=l.product_id AND s.branch=q.branch WHERE l.quote_id=$1 ORDER BY l.position,l.id

purchaseOrders.sql: SELECT *,supplier||' · '||branch||' · '||expected_date AS detail FROM calliope_apps.demo_receiving_orders WHERE supplier ILIKE '%'||$1||'%' OR id ILIKE '%'||$1||'%' ORDER BY expected_date,id LIMIT 30

po.sql:
SELECT p.*,current_date::text received_date,'09:00' received_time,'' reference,'' notes,
      coalesce((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(l.id,jsonb_build_object('quantity','0')) FROM calliope_apps.demo_receiving_lines l WHERE l.po_id=p.id),'{}'::jsonb) lines
      FROM calliope_apps.demo_receiving_orders p WHERE id=$1

poLines.sql: SELECT l.*,p.name,p.unit,round((l.expected-l.received)/100.0,2)::text remaining, '/state/receiptForm/lines/'||l.id||'/quantity' quantity_path FROM calliope_apps.demo_receiving_lines l JOIN calliope_apps.demo_counter_products p ON p.id=l.product_id WHERE po_id=$1 ORDER BY l.id

equipment.sql: SELECT *,model||' · '||serial AS identity FROM calliope_apps.demo_counter_equipment ORDER BY id

reports.sql: SELECT id,job_id,notes,attachments,coalesce(temperature,'') temperature,coalesce(pressure,'') pressure,coalesce(correction_of,'') correction_of,created||' · '||source AS detail FROM calliope_apps.demo_field_reports WHERE job_id=$1 ORDER BY created DESC,id LIMIT 20

fieldDefaults.sql: SELECT $1::text AS id,'' AS notes,'' AS temperature,'' AS pressure,'' AS correction_of,'[]'::jsonb AS attachments

case.sql:
SELECT c.id,c.version,c.title,c.notes,c.handoff,c.visit_id,c.po_id,jsonb_build_array(c.focus) focus,jsonb_build_array(c.role) role,
      CASE WHEN sum(l.backorder)>0 THEN 'waiting' WHEN j.status='Scheduled' THEN 'ready' ELSE lower(j.status) END phase,
      CASE WHEN sum(l.backorder)>0 THEN 'The replacement has not arrived. Receive and allocate stock before scheduling.' ELSE 'Parts are reserved. Review the return visit and handoff.' END reason,
      e.model||' · '||e.serial||E'\n'||e.service_notes equipment,
      coalesce((SELECT string_agg(h.scheduled_date||' · '||h.notes,E'\n' ORDER BY h.scheduled_date DESC) FROM (SELECT * FROM calliope_apps.demo_hvac_jobs WHERE customer=j.customer AND id<>j.id ORDER BY scheduled_date DESC LIMIT 4) h),'No previous visits') history,
      string_agg(p.name||': '||round(l.reserved/100.0,2)::text||' reserved / '||round(l.backorder/100.0,2)::text||' waiting',E'\n') parts
      FROM calliope_apps.demo_work_cases c JOIN calliope_apps.demo_hvac_jobs j ON j.id=c.visit_id JOIN calliope_apps.demo_counter_orders o ON o.visit_id=j.id
      JOIN calliope_apps.demo_counter_order_lines l ON l.order_id=o.id JOIN calliope_apps.demo_counter_products p ON p.id=l.product_id
      JOIN calliope_apps.demo_counter_quote_equipment qe ON qe.quote_id=o.quote_id JOIN calliope_apps.demo_counter_equipment e ON e.id=qe.equipment_id
      WHERE c.id='CASE-HARBOR' GROUP BY c.id,j.id,e.id

activity.sql:
WITH combined AS (SELECT 'j-'||id::text id,description,created FROM calliope_apps.demo_hvac_activity WHERE job_id=$1
      UNION ALL SELECT 'c-'||id::text,description,created FROM calliope_apps.demo_work_case_activity WHERE case_id='CASE-HARBOR'
      UNION ALL SELECT 'p-'||id::text,description,created FROM calliope_apps.demo_receiving_activity WHERE po_id=$2) SELECT * FROM combined
      ORDER BY created DESC,id LIMIT 12

decision.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN $1::text NOT IN ('adaptive','case') THEN jsonb_build_object('label','clarify','status','idle','steps',0)
      WHEN $2::text<>'auto' THEN jsonb_build_object('label',$2::text,'status','held','steps',0)
      ELSE rvbbit.decision_tree(CASE WHEN $1='case' THEN jsonb_build_object('facts',$3::jsonb || jsonb_build_object('readiness',$3::jsonb->>'phase','current_readiness_explanation',$3::jsonb->>'reason'),'notes',$4::text) ELSE jsonb_build_object('job',$5::jsonb,'notes',$6::text) END,
      CASE WHEN $1='case' THEN $7::jsonb ELSE $8::jsonb END,4) END AS decision

timeline.sql:
WITH slots AS (SELECT j.id,j.customer,j.slot,j.status,CASE j.technician WHEN 'Alex Morgan' THEN 0 WHEN 'Sam Rivera' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END lane,
      (extract(epoch FROM s.start::time)/60)::integer start,(extract(epoch FROM s."end"::time)/60)::integer "end"
      FROM calliope_apps.demo_hvac_jobs j JOIN calliope_apps.demo_dispatch_slots s ON s.job_id=j.id WHERE j.scheduled_date=$1 AND j.status<>'Complete' ORDER BY j.technician,s.start)
      SELECT jsonb_build_object('rows',coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(slots)),'[]'::jsonb),'positions',coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('lane',lane,'start',start,'end',"end")),'[]'::jsonb)) AS timeline FROM slots

chart_data.sql:
WITH visits AS (
      SELECT id,customer,technician,job_type,status,scheduled_date AS day,amount_cents/100.0 amount,(scheduled_date::date-current_date) AS day_index
      FROM calliope_apps.demo_hvac_jobs WHERE scheduled_date::date>=current_date-$2::integer AND ($3='Everyone' OR technician=$3)),
      parts AS (SELECT p.id,p.name,p.price_cents/100.0 price,sum(s.on_hand-s.reserved)/100.0 available FROM calliope_apps.demo_counter_products p JOIN calliope_apps.demo_counter_stock s ON s.product_id=p.id GROUP BY p.id),
      datasets AS (SELECT jsonb_build_object('visits',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(v)) FROM visits v),'[]'::jsonb),
       'parts',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p)) FROM parts p),'[]'::jsonb),'deals',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d)) FROM calliope_apps.demo_deals d),'[]'::jsonb),
       'regions',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('type','Feature','properties',jsonb_build_object('name',technician,'jobs',n),'geometry',jsonb_build_object('type','Polygon','coordinates',jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_array(-75+i,40),jsonb_build_array(-75+i,40.8),jsonb_build_array(-74.2+i,40.8),jsonb_build_array(-74.2+i,40),jsonb_build_array(-75+i,40)))))) FROM (SELECT technician,count(*) n,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY technician)::integer i FROM visits GROUP BY technician) regions)) AS data)
      SELECT jsonb_object_agg(key,jsonb_set(value,'{datasets}',datasets.data)) AS charts FROM jsonb_each($1::jsonb),datasets

overview.sql:
WITH deals AS (SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb)),
      jobs AS (SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements($2::jsonb)), tasks AS (SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements($3::jsonb))
      SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'value', '$'||to_char(coalesce((SELECT sum((value->>'price')::numeric) FROM deals WHERE value->>'stage'<>'Closed'),0),'FM999,999,990'),
        'active', (SELECT count(*)::text FROM deals WHERE value->>'stage'<>'Closed'),
        'open', (SELECT count(*)::text FROM tasks WHERE value->>'done'='0'),
        'visits', (SELECT count(*)::text FROM jobs),
        'scheduled', (SELECT count(*)::text FROM jobs WHERE value->>'status' IN ('Scheduled','Dispatched','On site')),
        'complete', (SELECT count(*)::text FROM jobs WHERE value->>'status'='Complete'),
        'offer', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(value) FROM deals WHERE value->>'stage'='Offer'),'[]'::jsonb),
        'diligence', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(value) FROM deals WHERE value->>'stage'='Due diligence'),'[]'::jsonb),
        'closing', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(value) FROM deals WHERE value->>'stage'='Closing'),'[]'::jsonb),
        'closed', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(value) FROM deals WHERE value->>'stage'='Closed'),'[]'::jsonb)) AS overview
